shared_elements: row of repeated short vertical strokes / fringe
bird-like or beaked creature (schematic in A, in relief in B)
justification: Both surfaces stack motifs in rough horizontal registers and both include a band of repeated short vertical strokes beneath a row of larger forms, plus profile creatures with legs and a hooked curving line, which gives a faint compositional echo. But the manner of making is entirely different — A is flat, broad-brushed red linear painting of highly schematic comb-like bodies, while B is three-dimensional carved relief with modelled, recognisably zoomorphic animals — so beyond generic register-and-animal correspondences there is nothing specific in common.
